text:
maya: Heads-up — I'm opening a quick thread to track edits to the new AZ7 region runbook and a short 'known issues' appendix. Need final signoff from infra and oncall before we hand off to SREs.

jesse: thanks. Can you paste the checklist you're proposing? want to make sure quota/iam bits are covered.

maya: quick draft checklist below (will move to confluence/PR after comments):
1) cloud quotas requested & confirmed (GPUs, CPUs, IPs)
2) audit of instance types (H100 vs A100 fallback plan)
3) VPC and subnet CIDR allocation confirmed / no overlap
4) MTU and ENI settings validated against east-west throughput tests
5) service account + KMS keys provisioned; RBAC mappings in place
6) kube bootstrapping + control-plane certificates rotation verified
7) basic perf smoke (single GPU, multi-GPU sync) + e2e inference test
8) cost guardrails (preemptible policy, autoscale limits, budget alerts)
9) runbook + known-issues appendix published; handoff meeting scheduled

li: add NTP / time sync checks to #4 — we hit drift in az5 and it caused kubelet flakiness.

maya: good call — adding NTP and chrony config snippet. Also adding a short troubleshooting flow for CNI flaps.

samir: what about driver mismatches for the nvlink stack? we've seen a mismatch between host driver and container runtime cause OOMs during large-batch runs. Maybe add pinned driver versions and a quick validation command.

maya: added. snippet in runbook: `sudo nvidia-smi -q | grep "Driver Version"` and `docker run --rm --gpus all nvidia/cuda:11.8-base nvidia-smi` to validate from host vs container.

taylor: for cost, please call out exactly which SKUs we should avoid for now. az7 quota was granted for A100-40GB only. if we try H100 without procurement it'll fail and autoscaler will get stuck in pending state.

maya: noted — will add an explicit mapping table: region -> allowed GPU SKUs -> fallback model. I'll also add a small autoscaler health probe so we can detect stuck pending nodes and alert.

jesse: LGTM for checklist. Two small asks: 1) include a short rollback for control-plane cert issues (how to revert to previous cert and force kubelet reconnect), 2) a tiny playbook for reclaiming leaked IPs (we had a classless allocation bug previously).

maya: adding both. For rollback I'll reference the existing cert-rotation doc and include `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart daemonset/kubelet` as the force-reconnect step. For leaked IPs I'll include the `gcloud compute addresses list --filter="status=RESERVED"` and who to ping in cloud-ops.

ops-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance window for az7 network provisioning at 2025-11-12T08:00Z. Channel #incidents will be used for outage comms.

samir: tiny nit — can we add a short verification for kernel parameters? `sysctl net.core.rmem_max` and `net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control` were important for our throughput tests.

maya: added kernel checks. Also adding a small known-issues appendix draft (will be editable):
- Issue A: CNI flapping after MTU mismatch. Symptoms: pods stuck in ContainerCreating, high retransmits. Workaround: set MTU to 9000 on host and set `cni.ifaceMtu` to 8950, then restart CNI plugin.
- Issue B: Kubelet crashloop with driver mismatch. Symptoms: kubelet OOM on large-batch tests; host `nvidia-smi` shows mismatched versions. Workaround: pin host driver to supported version and deploy sidecar that checks `nvidia-smi` during node boot.
- Issue C: Autoscaler pending nodes due to SKU quota. Symptoms: pending pods with `InsufficientGPUs`. Workaround: set emergency fallback to smaller model variant and notify procurement on-call.
- Issue D: Time drift causing certificate validation failures. Symptoms: kubelet cannot join control plane, TLS handshake errors in logs. Workaround: enable chrony and force sync: `chronyc -a makestep`

li: can we add a short repro for MTU issue? quick commands to reproduce would help oncall.

maya: sure — I'll add a minimal repro section:
```
# repro for MTU mismatch (dev only)
ip netns add test-ns
ip link add veth-host type veth peer name veth-ns
ip link set veth-ns netns test-ns
ip link set veth-host mtu 9000
ip netns exec test-ns ip link set veth-ns mtu 1500
# ping across the veths and watch for retransmits
```

taylor: +1 on repro. Also request: schedule the handoff meeting next Tue 16:00 UTC; invite infra, sres, and oncall.

maya: scheduling now and will open PR to confluence with the runbook + known-issues appendix. tagging everyone for final review. thanks y'all :thumbsup:

jesse: quick kb note — make sure to version the runbook with a patch tag e.g., `runbook/az7:v0.1` so we can roll back edits.

maya: will do. PR link when ready.

ops-bot: Reminder: new runbook PRs must include a smoke-check matrix and cost delta estimate per our doc policy.

maya: copy. I'll include the smoke matrix and a rough cost delta (est. +18% for A100-heavy workloads vs baseline region).

samir: nice. thanks for running this.

maya: thanks everyone — will post the PR and ping again for signoff.
